name: UCWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Contested in an eight-man tournament of real-wrestler-billed first-round matches (Sid vs. Flair, Vader vs. Hart, Diesel vs. Hogan, Luger vs. Michaels) at the fed's own launch PPV; this collection's own holdings end before any semifinal or final is recorded.
notes: Source: UCWF 'Bash for the Belts' (15 Jul 1996), part 3.

name: UCWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: A four-man first-round bracket (Undertaker over Arn Anderson, Ultimate Warrior over Ron Simmons, Lord Steven Regal over Mr. Perfect, Sabu over Chris Benoit) opens the fed's own launch PPV; no further round survives in this collection's own holdings.
notes: Source: UCWF 'Bash for the Belts' (15 Jul 1996), part 2.

name: UCWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: An eight-team tournament opens the fed's own launch PPV (Road Warriors, Sting and Razor Ramon, Harlem Heat and others all advance past the first round); this collection's own holdings end before a final is recorded.
notes: Source: UCWF 'Bash for the Belts' (15 Jul 1996), part 1.
